title: Currency-name corner billboard
slide_intent: Use repeated words at architectural scale so the breadth of an offer is legible at a glance.
strategic_value: Lists of currencies in bright green can make Wise’s international promise visible from the street.
demonstration: Two green billboards wrap a building corner; stacked currency names sit above card images and a small global promise.
practical_value: Compare how repeated headline lines and a recurring product image connect adjacent surfaces.

content_islands.name: Left billboard
content_islands.spec: Stack currency names above the card and bottom promise.

content_islands.name: Right billboard
content_islands.spec: Repeat the hierarchy with different currency names on the perpendicular face.

content_islands.spec: Keep building details and vehicles to establish scale.
